name: anun333/oe-module-migration
description: Migration into OpenEMR from other EHRs: reads the FHIR R4 export every certified EHR must offer (bulk NDJSON or Bundles), reports what maps before anything is written, then imports the core chart through OpenEMR's own services, safe to rerun

footprint-not-covered: Whether the permission checks above behave correctly for restricted users. They aren't yet checked end to end with a restricted login; the README says what each page asks for.
Whether another EHR's records map correctly. The unit tests in `tests/` cover the mapping; the end-to-end check, on synthetic FHIR exports against a running OpenEMR, is described in the README.
